recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成群的大型單核母細胞，核呈泡狀、染色質開放並有明顯核仁，可見分裂象（中央偏右）；周邊混有粉紅顆粒的成熟中骨髓細胞與嗜中性球，提示仍保有成熟分化的 AML。
features: Clusters of large mononuclear blasts with vesicular nuclei, open chromatin and distinct nucleoli (arrows)
Moderate amounts of pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Mitotic figure present among the blasts
Admixed maturing granulocytic precursors and neutrophils, including cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm
Scattered brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages and black granular pigment deposits (likely fixation artifact)
Intervening adipocytes; section appears to be of marrow particles/clot with some processing artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows hypercellular marrow with clusters of large blasts having vesicular nuclei, open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm; a mitotic figure is identified. Maturing myeloid precursors, including cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and segmented neutrophils, are present adjacent to the blast clusters. Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages and black granular pigment, likely fixation artifact, are noted. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, in keeping with AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1; blast enumeration on aspirate and confirmation by cytogenetics are required.

ddx.dx: Regenerating marrow with left shift (post-chemotherapy or G-CSF)
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows synchronized promyelocyte/myelocyte waves with abundant granular cytoplasm and paratrabecular maturation, not clusters of agranular nucleolated blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These form cohesive or sheet-like non-hematopoietic infiltrates negative for MPO/CD34 and positive for cytokeratin or B/T-cell markers.
Pronormoblasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and round dark nuclei and are E-cadherin/CD71 positive rather than MPO positive.
